personality_one_liner: A high-performance, task-scoped operational surface emphasizing live metrics, command-center clarity, and robust enterprise utility without visual friction.

spacing.rule: Dense information architecture with intentional utility. Tight spacing for metrics and live feeds, clear structural margins between operational modules.

do's: Use only on sticky tab bars or primary bottom sheets if content must bleed through.
dont's: Do not use on cards, lists, or metrics. Clarity and high contrast beat aesthetics in a command center.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Executive Command Dashboard showing real-time KPIs, AI summaries, and compliance alerts.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for KPI cards and a centered command spinner.
states.empty: No active modules connected - prompt to configure executive view.
states.error: Failed to fetch live ops data. Retry connection.

screens.layout: Top bar: Company Switcher dropdown. Main scroll: 2-column rigid grid for high-density KPI cards (revenue, employees, tickets). Below: 'Live Operations Feed' stacked list. Persistent primary CTA bottom-right (FAB) for 'Quick AI Action'.

screens.name: ModuleHub
screens.purpose: App Launcher organizing 60+ modules with search and role-based categories.

states.empty: No modules assigned to this user role.
states.error: Failed to load enterprise module schema.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top. Vertically scrolling rigid grid (3 columns). Grouped by category headers (People, Finance, Operations, IT) with dividers. High-contrast filled icons in surfaceTertiary tiles.

screens.name: AICommand
screens.purpose: Polished AI Command Center chat screen.

states.empty: Suggested prompt chips ('Summarize HR compliance', 'Show fleet status').

screens.layout: Top bar: Horizontal scroll of Assistant Selectors (HR, Accountant, Scheduler). Main area: Single-column chat stream, full-width. Bottom: Pinned composer input with attachment icons. Slide-in context panel for artifacts/data grids.

screens.name: HRList
screens.purpose: Employee records and HR management overview.

states.empty: No employees found in this subsidiary.

screens.layout: Filter chip row below header. Dense list view. Each row: Avatar/Initials, Name, Role, Status Badge (success/warning). Compact padding.

screens.name: Tickets
screens.purpose: Job Tickets and work order management.
screens.layout: Segmented control top (Open / In Progress / Closed). Stacked card layout with strict borders. Cards show Ticket ID (mono font), Title, Assignee, SLA countdown timer in brand accent.

screens.name: Schedule

states.empty: No shifts scheduled for selected date.

screens.layout: Horizontal date strip at top. Vertical timeline view of shifts, color-coded by department. Expandable rows for shift details.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK design personality. Prioritize high-density information, command-center clarity, and rigid 2-column or grid layouts.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for numbers, metrics, and large headers to enforce the operational dashboard aesthetic. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for all other readable text.
Ensure 'brandPrimary' (Rust/Ember) is used strictly for critical actions, live indicators, or high-priority SLA countdowns. Do not use it for backgrounds.
The AI Command Center must feature a task-scoped, single-column chat stream with a bottom-pinned composer, similar to enterprise AI workflows, using tight padding (16px).
Module Hub launcher must utilize a compact 3-column grid of icons within 'surfaceTertiary' tiles. Add role-based headers.
All cards must have a 0 shadow tier, relying instead on 1px borders ('border' or 'borderStrong') and surface color contrast to separate elements.
Ensure the Company Switcher on the Dashboard is prominently placed in the top bar as a dropdown.
For avatars or branded entities, use real fetched photos (e.g., employee_avatar_1). If none exist, fallback to initialized text inside a brandTertiary circle.
Implement haptics on module launches, tab switches, AI message sends, and quick action toggles to provide a tactile operational feel.
